fieldValues.title: AI agent
fieldValues.summary: An AI agent that starts from scratch every session and depends on the assumptions humans share to know where to focus, reading SRS context to reason and write structured records.
jobs: Recall the few records relevant to the task
Check where a claim came from
Hand work over to a human or another agent
Pick up where a previous session left off
fieldValues.needs: Fast scoped recall, provenance on everything, and write tools that enforce type and relation contracts.
